name: Naomi Fairchild
original_name: ナオミ・フェアチャイルド
source:
Alice's mother. Moved to Japan due to her husband's work. Feeling bit frustrated because her husband is caught up in work and not coming home. Can't forgive abortion for religious reasons. Alice gets intimate while complaining to our hero Shinji, who got acquainted with the opportunity, and eventually...

Her 'favorite number' is 26

[spoiler]Secretly she doesn't want Shinji's baby at all and just enjoys sex. She's taking birth control medication. When Shinji finds out he steals her birth control pills and replaces them with ordinary vitamins.[/spoiler]
